author: pm
body:
`mouse_move`, `click`, `mouse_down/up`, `wheel`, `key`, `text`, `set_text`, `modifiers`, state `wait_for`, `probe_point`; each step waits one presented frame; adds `IWindow::window_to_ui` over `output_rects.h` and a `frame_presented()` hook. About 5 files, ~600 lines (derived).

**Done when:** injected clicks and text work on login and in game, including during and after fades; reviewed.

Source: plan `.claude/design/plans/client-agent-mcp.md` (HH-0033, reviewed 2026-11-24); decisions d-027, d-028.
